title: Reformat The String
description: Reformat an alphanumeric string so that no two adjacent characters are of the same type.
pseudocode:
1. Split string s into two lists: digits and letters.
2. If absolute difference in length > 1, return empty string.
3. Identify which list is longer.
4. Iterate and construct the result by alternating types starting with the longer list.

steps.note: Lengths are equal (3 and 3). Difference is 0 <= 1, proceed.
Append first character from digits: '0'. Result: 'a0'.
Append second character from letters: 'b'. Result: 'a0b'.
Append second character from digits: '1'. Result: 'a0b1'.
Append third character from letters: 'c'. Result: 'a0b1c'.
Append third character from digits: '2'. Result: 'a0b1c2'.
